value: Giantess deck-builder prototype inspired by Slay-the-Spire Time to Complete: <10 minutes

Advance through a branching map of encounters to reach the boss. Use cards to gain temporary shields or damage enemies, gaining a choice out of new cards to add to your deck after each battle. Some card effects let you vore enemies which instantly destroys them and heals you in exchange for a temporary defense debuff.
